scripts.test: node scripts/test-answer-core.mjs && node scripts/test-pdf-dedup.mjs && node scripts/test-activities-paging.mjs && node scripts/test-dsml.mjs && node scripts/test-active.mjs && node scripts/test-course-cards.mjs

scripts.postbuild: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const pkg=require('./package.json');const f='YuketangStudio-'+pkg.version+'.user.js';if(!fs.existsSync('dist/'+f))throw new Error('产物缺失: '+f);fs.copyFileSync('dist/'+f,'dist/YuketangStudio-latest.user.js');console.log('✅ Build done: dist/'+f+' (+ YuketangStudio-latest.user.js)')"
scripts.test:lab: npm run check && npm run e2e:answer
scripts.test:all: npm run test:lab && npm run test:android
